description: This file defines the class AOS_PDF_TemplatesViewEdit, which extends a ViewEdit class to customize the editing view for PDF templates in the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods to set up form fields, load sample data, initialize TinyMCE editors, and prepare dynamic JavaScript configurations for PDF template editing.

classes.name: AOS_PDF_TemplatesViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to facilitate editing of PDF templates, with methods to set form fields, initialize rich text editors, and load sample data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to set up fields and TinyMCE editors before rendering.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Prepares dynamic form fields for PDF template editing, including loading sample files, generating module/field options, and JavaScript configurations.

methods.name: displayTMCE
methods.description: Initializes TinyMCE editors for PDF template description, header, and footer sections with specific configurations.
